newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end mixed, yen, marks pounds higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end mixed, yen, marks pounds higher.

text.p: March 21 - IMM currencies ended mixed, with yen, marks and sterling clinging to gains in light trade. June sterling ended the day above $1.60, supported by overnight U.K. manufacturing data. Market awaits Tuesday's FOMC meeting; remains uncertain about U.S.'s commitment to strong dollar policy, traders said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/))E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
